name: Unrestricted LP333 pq2 CryptoMiniSat parity-recovery discovery
hypothesis: CryptoMiniSat's CNF XOR recovery and Gauss-Jordan matrices may expose parity structure hidden inside the exact source-correct p37q3 formula and reach a directly verifiable unrestricted Legendre pair.
evidence_unit: one proofless SAT-discovery run on the audited unrestricted ID0 pq2 p37q3 slice with CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7, one thread, seed zero, frozen XOR and Gauss settings, and a 7200-second cap
claim_boundary: The uncompression statement is conjectural. Only a complete assignment satisfying all 4394496 serialized clauses and independently verifying two binary length-333 rows, all 74 prescribed length-37 margins, and combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts is a candidate. XOR telemetry and proofless UNSAT are nondecisive.

baseline.evidence: Correct formula SHA-256 99b7749b41a0eb81d235cda71e27d93241ee6fe4ee34361988fc5e3117cc1dea, 700291 variables, 4394496 clauses, and independent formula audit status pass.
baseline.measurement: No directly verified SAT model exists in the campaign for the source-correct prescribed rows [1,3 chi_37] and [1,-3 chi_37].

intervention.one_change: Replace parity-agnostic CDCL with pinned single-thread CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 and its frozen CNF XOR recovery plus bounded Gauss-Jordan matrices while keeping the exact p37q3 formula, seed, cap, compression, symmetry, and direct verifier fixed.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a partial or unaudited model

controls.name: correct-formula-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the specialization and all structural additions.
controls.expected: The independent audit verifies 333=37*3^2, energy 650, nonzero compressed PAF -18, all 215 lex leaders and 74 counters, exact formula hash, and a rejected mutation.

controls.name: tool-and-package-pin
controls.purpose: Bind the parity solver and its dynamically linked implementation.
controls.expected: CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 executable SHA-256 a3f85c3709b5e2a040bf82a4a604d1c7b9f10219bbf180a9e0f72319a2e892ac, library SHA-256 7952e5a5c77ac8b56253c7a2ad88c62648f20698004338bad9a443efb55b2f84, and Homebrew bottle receipt SHA-256 0309c0559340b1a766058556fad6691da0a97983d7a1195dcd4b7236f1ab33a3.

controls.name: parity-positive-control
controls.purpose: Check SAT status, model extraction, CNF satisfaction, and actual XOR and Gauss activation.
controls.expected: On known SAT ID3 cell 73, the pinned command returns SAT, its complete assignment satisfies every clause, and its trace reports recovered XORs and a used Gauss matrix.

controls.name: frozen-parity-settings
controls.purpose: Ensure the mechanism is a single parity-recovery arm.
controls.expected: One thread and seed zero with xor enabled, maximum XOR size 7, bounded XOR discovery and matrices, at most five matrices, and Gauss-useful cutoff 0.2.

controls.name: direct-target-model-audit
controls.purpose: Separate solver telemetry from mathematical evidence.
controls.expected: Any SAT assignment satisfies every CNF clause and independently verifies both full rows, all 74 margins, and every combined PAF equation; a controlled mutation is rejected.

primary_metric.name: directly verified unrestricted correct-p37q3 SAT models

terminal_outcomes.promote: CryptoMiniSat returns SAT and the complete assignment passes the exact CNF and independent direct full-length mathematical audit.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run reaches its cap or returns proofless UNSAT without a SAT model while formula, tool, positive-control, and parity controls remain valid.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A wall, memory, tool, extraction, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen arm.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any factorization, formula, tool, parity activation, complete-model, CNF, direct-PAF, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Require the passing independent correct-p37q3 formula audit.
Require the parity-positive-control trace and complete-model audit before target search.
Run one CryptoMiniSat process with the frozen settings, one thread, and seed zero.
Stop immediately on a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise terminate at 7200 solver seconds or 4 GiB observed RSS.
Do not rerun with another seed, thread count, configuration, formula, or larger cap.
Do not promote a proofless UNSAT status or parity trace.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, independently verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the non-SAT parity manifest and move to a distinct structural mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted manifest and resume only the remaining frozen budget if the interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula, tool, parity, extraction, or direct-verification defect before rerunning.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, official open-source solver code, and public primary literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
